info.name: OpenGov Receipt Receipt Surface Versions API
Get surface version status for a receipt

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

params.name: id
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

items.docs: Returns current max entry IDs for each surface (COMMENTS, ATTACHMENTS, ACTIVITY_LOG) and the user's last-viewed entry ID for each. Frontend uses the `isNewer` flag to render the 'New' badge. Called on side-panel mount.

info.name: Record surface views (mark up to entry IDs as seen)

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

params.name: id
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

items.docs: Body is an array of `{ surface, lastViewedEntryId }` pairs. Backend upserts rcp_user_surface_views records and bumps `viewed_count`. Returns 204 No Content. Called when the user opens a panel.
